Messages.Author: Ian batty
Messages.Body:
Although I now have about 2000 cards I am only fairly small time because I
buy my packs singly from the shops and they cost:

Jyhad starter ~ 5.99
VtES starter ~ 6.99
VtES booster ~ 1.99
Dark Sovs. ~ 1.79
A Hearts ~ 1.50

(All costs in Pounds Sterling and available in Manchester from Virgin
Megastore or Game.) (Exchange rate here is ~ 1 Pound = 1.50 US dollars.)

Does anyone know any better way to buy over here? I've checked one mail
order shop and they were just as expensive.

There is a lot of talk about 'boxes' of boosters - how many booster packs
are in a box?

By the way - how small time is 2000 cards? How many cards do the 'big
boys' like L Scott, Alex Chang etc. have?

Ian

Messages.Author: wig...@aol.com
Messages.Body:
I'm in the UK (Birmingham).

There is a shop in Birmingham called Dungeon's & Starships. They sell
boxes of boosters with a 20% discount. (tel: 0121 643 6008).

But by far the best is mail order from the states. I got an address from
the Duelist and managed to get a company in New York to ship Jyhad boxes
for around $35 each including shipping. They came through pretty quick
too.

Mel.
